variables.name: TIMEOUT
variables.description: Maximum TimeOut in seconds. The check fails above this. Remediation writes this value.

variables.name: MAX_KEEPALIVE_REQUESTS
variables.description: Minimum MaxKeepAliveRequests. The check fails below this. Remediation writes this value.

variables.name: KEEPALIVE_TIMEOUT
variables.description: Maximum KeepAliveTimeout in seconds. The check fails above this. Remediation writes 5 unless this ceiling is lower.

variables.name: REQUEST_READ_HEADER_MAX
variables.description: Maximum RequestReadTimeout header seconds. The check fails above this.

variables.name: REQUEST_READ_BODY_MAX
variables.description: Maximum RequestReadTimeout body seconds. The check fails above this.

variables.name: LIMIT_REQUEST_LINE
variables.description: Maximum LimitRequestLine. The check fails above this. Remediation writes this value.

variables.name: LIMIT_REQUEST_FIELDS
variables.description: Maximum LimitRequestFields. The check fails above this. Remediation writes this value.

variables.name: LIMIT_REQUEST_FIELDSIZE
variables.description: Maximum LimitRequestFieldsize. The check fails above this. Remediation writes this value.

variables.name: LIMIT_REQUEST_BODY
variables.description: Maximum LimitRequestBody in bytes. The check fails above this or when the body limit is unlimited. Remediation writes this value.

variables.name: KEY_MODES
variables.description: Comma-separated modes accepted for the TLS private key. Remediation applies the first value.

variables.name: SERVER_TOKENS
variables.description: Comma-separated ServerTokens values the check accepts. Remediation writes the first value.

variables.name: SERVER_SIGNATURE
variables.description: ServerSignature value the check requires. Remediation writes this value.
